thermal_subtitle: Temperatures, fan speeds and CPU load, read every two seconds while this page is open.
thermal_fan_stopped: The system has stopped the fan because the Mac is cool.
thermal_unsupported_desc: Viezan reads sensors on macOS through its bundled SMC reader and on Linux through hwmon. Windows is not supported yet.
thermal_reader_missing_desc: This copy of Viezan is missing viezan-smc. Reopen Viezan from a complete installation, or run npm run dev in the source checkout.
thermal_error_desc: Viezan could not read the sensors just now. Try again in a moment.
thermal_no_sensors_desc: This machine reports no temperature sensors that Viezan can read, so there is nothing to show here.
thermal_tray_enable_desc_menu_bar: The temperature stays in the menu bar and keeps updating every five seconds while this window is hidden.
thermal_tray_enable_desc_tray: The temperature appears in the tray icon tooltip and keeps updating every five seconds while this window is hidden.
thermal_tray_error: The menu bar option could not be saved.
thermal_fan_control_desc: Hold each fan at a fixed speed through Viezan's privileged fan helper. Automatic control returns by itself when the app quits, the helper loses contact, the Mac sleeps or wakes, or a sensor gets too hot.
thermal_fan_helper_unsupported: Fan control is available on macOS only.
thermal_fan_helper_missing: This copy of Viezan is missing the fan helper. Reopen Viezan from a complete installation, or run npm run dev in the source checkout.
thermal_fan_helper_idle_desc: Turning it on asks for an administrator password and starts the fan helper for this session only.
thermal_fan_helper_error_title: The fan helper could not be started
thermal_fan_sensor_missing: This sensor is not in the current reading; the fan keeps its last target.
thermal_fan_source_dialog_desc: Every raw sensor this machine reports. The fan will follow this one sensor only.
thermal_options_desc_fans: Fan sensor detection and the reading outside this window.
thermal_fan_calibrate_desc: Runs each fan at full speed for a short while and notes which sensors cool down, so every fan can follow the sensors next to it.
thermal_fan_calibrate_cancelled: Detection stopped; fans are back on automatic control.
thermal_fan_calibrate_confirm_title: Detect which sensors each fan cools
thermal_fan_profiles_desc: One setting for every fan, for a situation. Changing a fan by hand switches back to custom.
thermal_fan_profiles_need_helper: Turn on fan control to apply a profile.
thermal_fan_profile_error: The profile could not be applied.
thermal_fan_profile_builtin_quiet_desc: Fans stay at their minimum until the CPU passes 70°C.
thermal_fan_profile_builtin_cool_desc: Fans ramp from 45°C and reach full speed at 75°C on the CPU.
thermal_fan_profile_builtin_gaming_desc: Fans follow the GPU: ramp from 50°C, full speed at 80°C.
thermal_fan_profile_builtin_local_ai_des: Aggressive cooling for long model runs: ramp from 45°C, full speed at 70°C on the CPU.
thermal_fan_restored_reason: The fan helper returned the fans to automatic control ({reason}).
thermal_fan_disclaimer_intro_daemon: Viezan will install a small background fan helper with administrator rights. Your system asks for your password this once; after that Viezan reconnects by itself every time it opens, including after an update.
thermal_fan_helper_installed_desc: Installed. Viezan uses it without asking for your password again and puts your fan setting back after the app reopens or the Mac wakes.
thermal_fan_helper_not_installed_desc: Register the fan helper to let Viezan control fan speeds on this Mac.
thermal_fan_helper_outdated_title: A newer fan helper is available
thermal_fan_helper_outdated_desc: This version of Viezan comes with a new fan helper. Update to use it; macOS asks for your password once.
thermal_fan_helper_approval_title: Allow the fan helper in the background
thermal_fan_helper_approval_desc: Allow Viezan to run in the background in System Settings. Viezan checks permission when you return.
thermal_fan_disclaimer_intro: Viezan will start a small fan helper with administrator rights for this session. Your system will ask for your password.
thermal_fan_disclaimer_point_range: It only sets speeds within the range your machine reports
thermal_fan_disclaimer_point_restore: Every fan goes back to automatic when the app quits, the connection drops, or the machine sleeps or wakes
thermal_fan_disclaimer_point_ceiling: Fans also go back to automatic when a sensor crosses {ceiling}°C
thermal_fan_disclaimer_warning: Running fans slower than the system would can raise temperatures and shorten hardware life. You use this at your own risk.
thermal_fan_calibrate_confirm_intro: Viezan runs each fan at full speed for about a minute and compares temperatures, so each fan follows the sensors next to it.
thermal_fan_calibrate_confirm_point_time: It takes a few minutes and gets loud
thermal_fan_calibrate_confirm_point_spee: It only ever speeds fans up, never slows them down
thermal_fan_calibrate_confirm_point_setu: Keep the machine on a flat surface and avoid heavy work meanwhile

launcher_spotlight_replaced: Spotlight shortcut turned off. Viezan Launcher now opens with Command+Space.

appsDataCleanupPlatformHint: App reset and data cleanup are available only on macOS. Viezan does not clean residual files on Windows/Linux.
appsUninstallRegistryHint: Opens the registered Win32/MSI uninstaller. It may request UAC permission and determines which data is deleted. Viezan cannot undo this.
appsUninstallMsixHint: Opens Installed apps in Windows Settings to manage Microsoft Store/MSIX apps. Opening Settings does not uninstall an app. The Store list may be incomplete.
appsUninstallFlatpakUserHint: Removes the Flatpak from your account without root access. App data is kept; no separate cleanup runs. Viezan cannot undo this.
appsUninstallFlatpakSystemHint: Removes the system Flatpak, affecting all users. After this confirmation, pkexec/Polkit requests administrator permission. App data is kept; Viezan cannot undo this.
appsUninstallSnapHint: Removes the system Snap, affecting all users. After this confirmation, pkexec/Polkit requests administrator permission. Snap manages data under its own rules; Viezan performs no extra cleanup and cannot undo this.
appsUninstallDebHint: Removes the package system-wide with apt. A package may contain multiple apps, and apt may remove dependent packages. After this confirmation, pkexec/Polkit requests administrator permission. No purge or separate autoremove runs; Viezan cannot undo this.
appsUninstallRpmHint: Removes the package system-wide with dnf. A package may contain multiple apps, and dnf may remove dependent packages. After this confirmation, pkexec/Polkit requests administrator permission. No purge or separate autoremove runs; Viezan cannot undo this.
appsUninstallAppImageHint: Moves only the selected AppImage file to Trash; keeps the .desktop launcher and app data. Undo by restoring the file from the OS Trash. Viezan has no restore button.
